description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers an unresolved cross-workspace import and the workspace: protocol that fixes it, including the editor-resolves-build-fails signature of a tsconfig paths patch. Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbors: a third-party package that is genuinely missing, structural orientation (monorepo-workspace), impact analysis (blast-radius-analyzer), a TypeScript type error that is not a resolution failure, and a general dependency upgrade.
